mapper.sql: strategy_id AS strategyId, account_id AS accountId, name, symbol, strategy_type AS strategyType, side, target_price AS targetPrice, order_type AS orderType, short_window AS shortWindow, long_window AS longWindow, band_period AS bandPeriod, band_k AS bandK, quantity, max_notional AS maxNotional, max_orders_per_day AS maxOrdersPerDay, max_position AS maxPosition, status, stop_reason AS stopReason, last_state AS lastState, last_price AS lastPrice, last_evaluated_at AS lastEvaluatedAt, consecutive_failures AS consecutiveFailures, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM trading_strategy WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY strategy_id
SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM trading_strategy WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY symbol
SELECT FROM trading_strategy WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, strategy_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trading_strategy WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status <> 'COMPLETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_strategy (account_id, name, symbol, strategy_type, side, target_price, order_type, short_window, long_window, band_period, band_k, quantity, max_notional, max_orders_per_day, max_position, status) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{name}, #{symbol}, #{strategyType}, #{side}, #{targetPrice}, #{orderType}, #{shortWindow}, #{longWindow}, #{bandPeriod}, #{bandK}, #{quantity}, #{maxNotional}, #{maxOrdersPerDay}, #{maxPosition}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE trading_strategy SET status = #{status}, stop_reason = NULL, consecutive_failures = 0, last_state = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'ACTIVE' THEN NULL ELSE last_state END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
UPDATE trading_strategy SET consecutive_failures = 0 WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId}
UPDATE trading_strategy SET status = 'STOPPED', stop_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE trading_strategy SET status = 'COMPLETED', stop_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT execution_id AS executionId, strategy_id AS strategyId, event_id AS eventId, signal, price, quantity, status, order_id AS orderId, reason, created_at AS createdAt FROM strategy_execution WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, execution_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT 'ORD-' || order_id FROM orders WHERE idempotency_key LIKE 'strategy-' || #{strategyId} || '-%' ORDER BY order_id DESC LIMIT 1
